messages.subject: RFQ pump shaft HX (part:320070) – complete packages for your review
messages.body:
Dear Mr Dralveck,

Thank you for your quote and your readiness to start. Please review the material and energy basis of your costing.

The stainless bar index fell from 3182.67 (idx:AS-14404@2026-06) to 3007.80 (idx:AS-14404@2026-09), a change of -5.49%.
The producer price index for this cost driver fell from 131.9 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-05) to 129.1 (idx:PPI-C2431@2026-08), a change of -2.12%.
A current competing offer stands at EUR 35.00 per unit (offer:70240-1).

The attached complete packages cover 4200 pc per year over 24 months. Payment within 30 days is possible in one variant. What is your earliest lead time? Are there cheaper variants, such as bar stock or batch sizes, you could suggest?

Kind regards
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

messages.subject: Re: RFQ pump shaft HX (part:320070) – complete packages for your review
messages.body:
Hallo,
thanks for the mail.
we can move a bit:
Our terms: a price of €31.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, Lieferzeit 28 days.
Here is how it is:
We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
As to the index change and rival quote data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point.
Hallo, I checked your index numbers and you are right about the material costs dropping.
I can give you a new price of €31.00, but I need you to agree to 14 days payment terms to help with our cash flow.
28 days lead time is the fastest we can do, and we are already using standard bar stock to keep it cheap.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 14 days net: €31.00 per unit.
Our Lieferzeit is 28 days.
With overtime we can deliver in 28 days, at a premium.
We have free capacity for your parts.
From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 1.10 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.82 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.51 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.
Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351.
Back to the machines now.
Gruß
Andreas Dralveck
Owner, Zerspanung Dralveck GmbH

messages.subject: Re: RFQ: pump shaft for the new HX series
messages.body:
Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the rival quote data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. Our price follows our main cost drivers: LCI-C, PPI-C2431, AS-14404, PPI-D351.

To show we're really eager to get this going, I can do 31.00 EUR. But we gotta stick to 52 days lead time and 45 days payment, 90 days is just too long for us to wait for the money. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 45 days net. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price.

Right now, our main offer stands at a price of €35.00 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, Lieferzeit 35 days. Alternatively, with standard terms of Zahlungsziel 45 days net and Lieferzeit 52 days: €31.00 per unit. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Jana Procházková
Export Manager, Strojírna Hrvelec s.r.o.

Freight Forwarder: Our Lieferzeit is 35 days. With overtime we can deliver in 35 days, at a premium.
